Company Description Delight Events is a Kuwait-based event planning company that has been creating memorable experiences since 2019. The team specializes in designing and executing a wide range of events, including weddings, corporate functions, and private gatherings. With a strong focus on creativity and attention to detail, Delight Events works closely with clients to bring their visions to life and consistently exceed expectations. The company is driven by a commitment to excellence and aims to deliver events that inspire joy and leave a lasting impression. Professionals joining Delight Events become part of a collaborative team dedicated to high-quality service and customer satisfaction.

Role Description The Sales Business Development Executive is a full-time, on-site role based in Kuwait City. This position is responsible for identifying and pursuing new business opportunities, generating qualified leads, and building a strong pipeline of potential clients for Delight Events. The role involves conducting market research, networking, and meeting with prospective clients to understand their event needs and present suitable solutions. The Executive will manage key accounts, maintain long-term client relationships, and collaborate with the events team to ensure proposals and contracts align with client expectations. Daily activities include preparing sales presentations, following up on inquiries, negotiating terms, and contributing to revenue targets while upholding the company’s service standards.

d: Lean is hiring a Talent Acquisition Manager to operate in a player-coach role: leading a small talent team while owning GTM & Business hiring. You'll manage and develop the team, drive hiring quality and speed, and act as a strategic partner to leadership. If you're someone who raises the bar on every hire, builds systems that outlast you, and takes pride in the caliber of people joining a company, this role is for you.

Lean is the leading financial infrastructure provider in the Middle East. We power some of the region's largest companies with APIs that enable payments, account verification, financial data access, and other critical financial infrastructure.

What started as the region's pioneering Open Banking platform and quickly became the de facto leader in account aggregation and payment initiation in the region is now becoming something bigger: a multi-product infrastructure company powering payments, data, and lending across MENA.

We've processed billions of dollars in transactions. We're trusted by 450+ clients - from Binance and Careem to Etisalat - and backed by General Catalyst, Sequoia, and Shorooq. Our $67.5M Series B was just the beginning. We're expanding into new markets, opening offices, acquiring businesses, and building capabilities that didn't exist here before.
